'''Jocend''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The commander of the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial]] warship [[Overlord (warship)|''Overlord'']], Jocend and his ship were [[Battle of Makem Te (Cold War)|captured]] by Republic forces above [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]] after the ship was damaged in an earlier battle.

==Biography==
[[File:Overlord.png|thumb|right|224px|Jocend's ship, the ''Overlord'', is attacked by Republic forces]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Jocend served the Empire during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], he was the commander of the [[Overlord (warship)|''Overlord'']], an Imperial [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class Dreadnaught]]. That same year, Jocend led an illegal attack on the Republic border with an Imperial task force, but the ''Overlord'' was badly damaged and separated from its escorts.<ref name="TOR" />

Jocend attempted to hide the ''Overlord'' in the upper atmosphere of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], but the Republic learned of the ship's presence and sent the [[Coruscant Aegis]] Squadron to cripple the ship. The Republic forces successfully crippled and boarded the ''Overlord'', capturing the ship and Jocend himself.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jocend was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He is mentioned in the mission briefing for the Space Battle: "Makem Te Assault" for Republic players. In the mission, the player cripples the ''Overlord'' above Makem Te so that the Republic could capture the ship.<ref name="TOR" />
